verdict.rationale: Jan is a local LLM desktop app, so Apple Silicon acceleration is a fair question to ask of it. The pack never mentions Apple Silicon, ARM builds, Metal, or GPU acceleration. Saying the API server is "powered by llama.cpp" names an underlying engine, not a documented Metal or ARM optimization by Jan itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get accelerated inference on Apple Silicon via native ARM and Metal optimizations
